acceptance_evidence.evidence: contract_hash=sha256:02c32a1a1f1ee6a0f9a99f64b35a3412cd06ebd2ff554af57a00daafb5dfb20b; accepted discovery checkpoint PR-001-discovery.json identifies the concrete lifecycle defect: launch records bounded diagnostics in PumarejoRuntime.#diagnostics, then public diagnostics requires an active session and returns SESSION_NOT_ACTIVE after the failed launch. The focused regression drives an asynchronous SESSION_CREATE_FAILED, phase, and process stderr through the owned launch callbacks, queries diagnostics while idle, and checks close and relaunch isolation.

contract_hash=sha256:02c32a1a1f1ee6a0f9a99f64b35a3412cd06ebd2ff554af57a00daafb5dfb20b; src/mcp/runtime.ts now exposes the retained bounded store only after a failed launch has settled idle, retains it through launch cleanup, closes it on explicit close, and closes the prior store before replacement. Surface-scoped queries remain fail-closed without an owned active surface, and existing successful-session cleanup/routing paths remain unchanged. tests/unit/mcp-runtime.test.ts covers sanitized phase, stderr, last_error, close clearing, relaunch isolation, and stale surface denial.
